outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially open in frame 0 (image, left_ego_image). The robot approaches and aligns with the door, then raises it toward the oven during frames 62–77 (image, left_ego_image). The door is visibly closed by frames 78–85 and remains closed as the gripper withdraws through frame 104 (image, left_ego_image; wrist_image provides the close-range view during withdrawal). No failed attempt, unintended object displacement, or other side effect is visible.
